data.one_liner: An auto-completion engine for Dart and Flutter using an optimized Trie implementation.
data.what_it_does: Provides an in-memory auto-completion engine based on a space-efficient Trie data structure. It supports frequency and recency-based sorting, basic file persistence, and Hive box extensions for searching keys and values.
use_when: You need local, fast auto-completion suggestions for strings in Dart or Flutter
You want suggestions ranked by frequency of entry and recency
You want basic file persistence or Hive integration for autocomplete data
avoid_when: You need advanced sorting options directly integrated with Hive box search
You require complex remote search indexing rather than a local Trie
strengths: Space-efficient Trie implementation using variable-length lists
Flexible sorting options including frequency and recency-based logistic curves
Built-in file persistence and Hive integration extensions
weaknesses: Hive integration does not support advanced custom sorting options (only entry-level sorting)
